verdict.rationale: Segment's own docs say Audiences built from events, traits and computed traits can be synced to hundreds of Destinations, and that Engage is powered by real-time data. However, nothing documents continuous sync cadence, users entering and exiting audiences in near-real-time, or ad-platform destinations specifically. Missing for 10: documented real-time entry/exit membership updates, explicit continuous (vs. batch) audience sync, named ad-platform audience destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time

citations.quote: You can then sync Audiences to hundreds of Destinations
Powered by real-time data, Twilio Engage is a customizable personalization platform with which you can build, enrich, and activate Audiences.
Destinations allow you to act on your data and learn more about your customers in real time.
